theme: An open day, an early start tomorrow.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is wide open today, with the next fixed thing an early ICGN planning call tomorrow at 7:30. A clear day like this is the moment to close out the travel bookings that have been idling.

needsAttention.title: Read the ICGN plenary outline
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 7:30 AM planning call for the ICGN Toronto Plenary 7 on stewardship data expects everyone to have reviewed the session outline Claudia circulated. Skim it today so you arrive with a point of view rather than reacting cold.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority note to book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has sat open since mid-September. A full-size SUV at PWM over the holidays is the hardest rental in that market, and a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Settle the December-break trip
needsAttention.detail: The December-break destination was meant to be decided by Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15, and both dates have passed. Holiday inventory for six people across three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the domestic-vs-international call is worth making today.

schedule.title: Cottage stay in St. Pete begins
schedule.detail: Coffee Pot Bayou, Old NE, through Nov 2

flagged.title: Board-search advisor reached out
flagged.detail: Elijah at Aurevane Search, an independent board-composition advisory, opened a thread on governance trends - worth a read given the board search.

flagged.title: LinkedIn message still waiting
flagged.detail: Hans-Kristian Bryn messaged you on LinkedIn three days ago and it is still unanswered.

flagged.title: Mike sent a sailing open house
flagged.detail: Mike forwarded an Intelligent Sailing open house invitation.

flagged.title: Reunion is collecting photos
flagged.detail: The B'Yachad reunion organizer is gathering photos and RSVPs, 31 days out.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and seasonal promotions - Thanksgiving tables, fall sales, and a couple of newsletters.
inbox.clear: Nothing urgent is sitting unanswered this morning.

recipe.title: Vin santo-roasted pears
recipe.why: Autumn pears are at their peak now, and slow-roasting with vin santo turns them silky.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar - the open stretch the Christmas rental and December-break decisions have been waiting for.
Still clear; the ICGN Plenary 7 outline is the one document worth opening before tomorrow's early call.
An early alarm ahead, with the Toronto planning call opening at 7:30 tomorrow morning.
